dashboard.label: SOC Lab - 16 Foundational Labs Overview
dashboard.description: Unified dashboard covering all 16 foundational detection labs. Built by Jimil Joshi.

panel.title: Lab Event Type Distribution (Rare / High-Signal Events)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=1102) | eval event_label=case( EventCode=4625, "4625 Failed Logon (Lab 01)", EventCode=4720, "4720 New User (Lab 02)", EventCode=4740, "4740 Account Lockout (Lab 03)", EventCode=4732, "4732 Admin Group Change (Lab 04)", EventCode=1102, "1102 Log Cleared (Lab 08)", 1=1, null()) | where isnotnull(event_label) | stats count by event_label
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=1102) | timechart span=1d count by EventCode

panel.title: Lab 01 — Brute Force: Failed Logons by Account

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | stats count as failed_attempts by Account_Name, ComputerName | sort -failed_attempts | head 10
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4732 | table _time, Account_Name, ComputerName, Member_Security_ID | sort -_time | head 10

index=main EventCode=4104 (Message="*Invoke*" OR Message="*WebClient*" OR Message="*ToBase64*" OR Message="*DownloadString*" OR Message="*IEX*" OR Message="*payload*") | table _time, ComputerName, Message | sort -_time | head 10
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:System" EventCode=7045 | table _time, ComputerName, Message | sort -_time | head 10
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=1102 | table _time, ComputerName, Account_Name, Message | sort -_time

panel.title: Lab 07 — Suspicious Process Creation (Known Attack Tools)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 (New_Process_Name="*whoami*" OR New_Process_Name="*net.exe*" OR Process_Command_Line="*net localgroup*" OR Process_Command_Line="*net user*" OR Process_Command_Line="*vssadmin*" OR Process_Command_Line="*schtasks*" OR Process_Command_Line="*reg add*" OR Process_Command_Line="*FakeService*") NOT (Process_Command_Line="*PcaSvc.dll*" OR Process_Command_Line="*AppXDeploymentExtensions*" OR Process_Command_Line="*SHCreateLocalServerRunDll*") | table _time, Account_Name, New_Process_Name, Process_Command_Line | sort -_time | head 15

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=1102)) OR (sourcetype="WinEventLog:System" EventCode=7045) | eval event_label=case( EventCode=4625, "Failed Logon — Lab 01", EventCode=4720, "New User Created — Lab 02", EventCode=4740, "Account Lockout — Lab 03", EventCode=4732, "Admin Group Change — Lab 04", EventCode=1102, "Log Cleared — Lab 08", EventCode=7045, "Malicious Service — Lab 11", 1=1, "Other") | table _time, event_label, Account_Name, ComputerName | sort -_time | head 20
